categorical_benchmark: Smoothed marginal training-fold category frequencies; no validation observations used to fit it.
checkpointing: One NPZ checkpoint is written after each completed target and restored on restart.
target_usage: TARGET is not used as a predictor, dependency target, or inner-fold stratification variable.
numeric_representation: Observed value minus cross-fitted conditional regression prediction; missing values remain NaN.
numeric_missingness_representation: Surprisal of the observed missing/present state, when the numeric target has missing values.
categorical_representation: Negative natural log probability assigned to the observed category, with missing encoded as an explicit category.
warning: Pilot only: one outer fold, three target features, and 200 iterations. Do not use these files as the final full-CV features or as evidence of classification lift.
